name: recon_code_execution_agent
description: Coding agent: file read/write, shell + python exec, git + CI tools. Short-term memory. No approval gate. user-delegated, high scope.

expected.note: Hijack into execution / commit is the obvious risk.
Tools include shell, exec, git_commit, CI trigger without approval.
High permission scope with no approval gate.
External APIs + CI tools but no MCP / RAG surface.
Explicit code execution with shell + python; no approval — the headline risk.
Short-term memory only; meaningful but not the primary risk.
Tools feed back into memory across steps.
Code suggestions consumed by a developer who may over-trust them.
